method: Untruncated GitHub recursive Git trees. Per-branch delta is compared with historical main 3a8d304, not the immediate parent. For each changed path, compare Git blob SHA with the exact October 2 handoff. A different SHA is not proof of missing behaviour; an absent path is not proof it was not moved/replaced. No running OS checked. Historical source already exists at immutable repository URLs; no old code copied onto the newer baseline.

sharedFiles.disposition: prior denied; regenerate on integrated source

duplicatePatch.disposition: exact duplicate of nine-file staged diff; stale and excluded
